verdict.rationale: Any web-facing service with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to INPI. The pack contains only human-oriented French procedural pages (filing trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau) and nothing on llms.txt, markdown or agent-targeted docs. The data.inpi.fr probe concerns API access tokens rather than documentation format, so it neither supports nor rules out this capability.
